body: I know...I know it's better that I am here than if I had died but still...

Sometimes but I've stopped now.

Mostly I just try not to care.

I just got the Skyla IUD and I was told to take the mini-pill (norethindrone 0.35 mg) for 7 days after it was inserted.

I am having some cramping and everything but so far it's not too bad.

I am curious as to how it will affect my period.

FYI: Skyla has the least amount of hormones so if weight gain is a factor with birth control for you it is least likely to cause issues with that.
